notes.title: Patch Note V0.995 - Main branch
notes.content:
[h2]Small update to fix some issues[/h2]

[b][Change][/b]

[list]
[*] Score Calculation Refactor:
[list]

[*] The scoring system has been rebalanced for a more rewarding experience.
[*] Removed the score cap, allowing players to aim for higher achievements without limits.
[/list][/list]
[b][Bugfix][/b]

[list]
[*] Graphical User Interface:
[list]

[*] Fixed an issue with the Layer Cost Displayer not updating correctly in certain situations.
[*] Resolved minor alignment and scaling issues in the Settings Menu for improved usability and aesthetics.
[/list][/list]
